verifier.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
verifier.rule: The reply is stripped of surrounding whitespace and of the characters .,!?"'* and lower-cased. If its last word contains 'pass' the rule passed; else if it contains 'fail' the rule failed; else the rule passed if 'pass' occurs anywhere in the reply. A call that still failed after its retries leaves the rule unscored.
verifier.method: The rules of an item are asked in order, one call per rule; after a failed rule the item has failed and its remaining rules are recorded as skipped. An item without a translation fails every rule without a call.

aggregation: An item passes when every one of its verification rules passed. The pass rate is the share of passed items; unsupported and empty items count as failed. Systems with any unscored item are listed as incomplete and not summarized.

bootstrap.description: 95% percentile intervals of 2,000 draws of items with replacement (NumPy PCG64, seeded with the first eight bytes of SHA-256 of the seed string): the draws over all items come first, then those over the items in the release's directions; every system gets the same draws.
